title: SCP-151, The Painting
description: An anomalous painting that makes you drown if you see's it
body:
The Painting adds a new item. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-151, also known as The Painting.


SCP-151 can be found inside its containment chamber and interacts directly with players who observe it. Using wool, players can cover the painting to make it safe. If left uncovered, it becomes extremely dangerous. Players who observe SCP-151 uncoverd will drown within the next few minutes.

<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-151 spawn?

SCP-151 spawns in a containment chamber, usually underground in plains and meadow biomes. There may be multiple SCP-151.

</details>



![SCP-151](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/536139378e3247cf832ef1dd13018c5ce0fa4a06.png)

SCP-151 is a blue anomalous oil painting, apparently from the perspective of someone underwater, located inside a containment chamber. Players can right-click SCP-151 using any color of wool to cover it, which prevents its anomalous effect. If SCP-151 is not covered, any player who looks directly at the painting will begin to drown, regardless of their location or whether they are in water.
